objective: complete pinned DXVK's ordinary D3D9/global buffer allocation chain with native core requirements2 and device-address queries while preserving typed ownership and a pointer-free wire

source.dedicated_resource_sequence: lines 1014-1030 create a buffer then issue core vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2; lines 1083-1098 legacy-bind it and issue core vkGetBufferDeviceAddress only after a successful bind
source.global_allocation_sequence: lines 1397-1423 create the global buffer, issue core vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2, legacy-bind memory, then conditionally issue core vkGetBufferDeviceAddress
source.device_address_helper: lines 2304-2310 build a VkBufferDeviceAddressInfo with an implicit null pNext and call core vkGetBufferDeviceAddress

requirements_input.buffer: existing buffer returned by vkCreateBuffer on the same device

address_input.buffer: same typed buffer, after successful memory binding

call_order: vkGetBufferDeviceAddress when shader-device-address usage is present

wire.representation: fixed-width little-endian typed buffer ID, bounded pNext flags, scalar requirements, booleans, and device address
wire.native_reconstruction: the Bionic service resolves the buffer's owning device and native handle, then reconstructs all Vulkan records in local memory

fail_closed: wrong structure types, wrong-type or missing buffer IDs, or cross-device buffer ownership
any input pNext, any output pNext except one terminal VkMemoryDedicatedRequirements, or any address-info pNext
unknown pNext bits, nonzero reserved wire bytes, noncanonical booleans, zero requirements, or a zero native address
truncated, oversized, or incorrectly typed request and response payloads

dispatch_policy.promotion: core vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2 and core vkGetBufferDeviceAddress only
dispatch_policy.aliases: vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2KHR and vkGetBufferDeviceAddressKHR remain required_unimplemented; vkGetBufferDeviceAddressEXT remains probed_null. Pinned DXVK invokes core spellings and this gate does not claim separate native alias support.

verification.canonical_codec: round trips both fixed-width commands and rejects unknown pNext flags, nonzero reserved bytes, invalid booleans, and zero addresses
verification.cross_process_fake_driver: verifies the exact core structures and native fake buffer, returns size 4096/alignment 256/type bit 1 and optional preferred-not-required dedicated booleans, requires memory binding before returning address 0x123456780000
verification.unsupported_chain_contract: the client leaves deterministic zero requirements or returns address zero without issuing an RPC

remaining_risks: real Turnip requirements2 and buffer device-address execution remain unproven until a tablet deployment
the logical device must enable bufferDeviceAddress before DXVK uses the address call; the pinned feature-create chain is covered elsewhere but this host fake does not emulate feature gating
dedicated buffer allocation through VkMemoryDedicatedAllocateInfo.buffer remains unsupported by the current bounded allocation wire
a runtime trace may expose another required command after this mapped allocation chain
next_runtime_boundary: For DXVK global buffers up to its own 256 MiB MaxChunkSize, the audited ordinary create/requirements/allocate/legacy-bind/address sequence is complete; deploy and capture the first new resolver or native-call failure rather than speculating beyond the pinned path.
reuse: The required deja search found no indexed implementation. E068 reuses E046 typed same-device ownership, E056 and E063 bounded local pNext reconstruction, E066 requirements-response validation, and the existing E034/E066 generated dispatch-policy mechanism.
